defs.def: a large round bowl for holding liquids or (in British English) for preparing foods in; the amount of liquid, etc. in a basin 盆；（英式英语）调菜盆；一盆（的量）

ex.s: As a national park and nature reserve, Jiuzhaigou Valley just north of the Sichuan Basin, is home to mighty snow-capped mountains, thick forests alive with wildlife, impressive waterfalls and lakes so blue that they take our breath away.
ex.t: 起初，教练问他是否是来试训的，他回答说他只是来领装备的。

defs.def: an area of land around a large river with streams running down into it 流域
a place where the earth's surface is lower than in other areas of the world 盆地；凹地；海盆
a sheltered area of water providing a safe harbour for boats 港池；内港；内湾；船坞

ex.s: He directed the wasted water into shallow basins where it froze, and was stored until the spring.
ex.t: 他将这些浪费的水引入浅水池中冻结储存，直到春天使用。

ex.s: There is no equipment, and since there isn’t even a washroom, if I need water I have to carry it from my house in a basin!
ex.t: 起初，我惊讶地发现所有的设备都是旧的，所以我们不得不手动完成所有的任务。
